answer: To prevent Sybil swarms from overwhelming an agent economy, nodes publish zero-knowledge proofs validating cryptographic attestation chains of past compute without leaking secrets. Even if rogue bots whisper collusion across an umber network backdrop, superlinear staking costs make swarm replication mathematically ruinous.
